utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we ask for more volunteers, can we confirm Saturday’s set and whether the only confirmed repairs are still the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many repairs are actually confirmed right now, Hana, and who’s updating the shared list so we can lock Saturday’s set today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t want to guess—last I was checking, it looked like just the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, but we still need Jules to confirm whether there’s a third repair and who’s updating the shared list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m all set for Saturday at 9, Dane—I'll bring my toolbox and help with the small fixes and sorting donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam—and sorry I’m late. That sounds great; with your toolbox, we should be in good shape for the small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help, Dane—if you want, I can also get there a few minutes early to help set things up before we start.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Kira, the repair drive’s moving along nicely—we’re meeting by the community shed at nine, sorting the tools, and then splitting up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but are we actually set on it yet—can you confirm who’s definitely coming and exactly what tools each person is bringing first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re set on the plan by the shed at nine, and I’ve been telling everyone that; Eli’s definitely bringing the extension cords, and we’ll sort the rest of the tools there before we split up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Faye — the repair drive’s coming together for next Saturday at the community center lot, and I’m just waiting on the final okay this afternoon before I send the exact time around.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — I can help after school drop-off, as long as I’m free again for pickup around 2:45 to 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot, Faye — I’ll send the confirmed time as soon as I get the okay, and I’ll keep that pickup window in mind.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Cleo, I’ve got the repair drive marked for Maple Street by the community garden, and we’re meeting first at the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—that helps; I’m still checking the bins, but I know we’ve got spare screws, tape, and some gloves, and I’ll let you know if the small screwdriver set turns up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo—that’s helpful; I’ve got Maple Street by the community garden noted, with the community center lot as our meetup, so just let me know if that small screwdriver set turns up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think we’re still meeting by the community shed, but I’m still trying to pin down who’s coming and what tools they’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good—I’ve been telling everyone, so I’ll keep spreading the word and round up who’s coming and what tools they can bring for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Quinn—that helps a lot; if you can send me the names and tools once you’ve got them, I can finally make sure we’re actually set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Leo — we’re meeting by the community shed at nine to sort tools and split up, and I’m bringing the extension cords. If you can stick to that plan, the repair drive should go smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning, Eli — I’m keeping it at Saturday at 10 in my driveway, so bring the cords there and we’ll sort tools on site.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, Leo — if it’s Saturday at ten in your driveway now, I’ll bring the extension cords there; just send around the updated plan so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, the repair drive’s really coming together—folks have been dropping off tools all morning, and it’s set for Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear, but I still need a clear headcount and a list of who’s bringing what before I can relax about Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, I’m passing that around now—Sam’s helping, tools are already coming in, and I’ll make sure we’ve got a proper headcount and list before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday at 10 at Leo’s driveway, right? I think it’s mostly the bench, fence panel, and that bus stop light left.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve only got the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence confirmed so far, and as far as I know Saturday’s still the plan. Let me check on the rest before we count them in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—just ping me once you’ve confirmed what’s actually on the list, and I’ll plan around Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: First up are the wobbly bikes and the lamp rewiring, and we could really use a couple more hands on the bike side.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I can help on the bike side. How many bikes are we looking at so far?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a big help, Rey—we’ve got three wobbly bikes lined up so far, and I’m starting there by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, I’m still out running errands, but how’s the repair drive shaping up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, Ira—sounds like it’s this Saturday over by Maple Street near the community garden, with folks like Rosa and Quinn helping organize.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, got it—that sounds promising. I’m still out running errands, but keep me posted if you hear anything more solid about the setup or timing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Gus, the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center on Maple Street by the community garden, and I’m still firming up the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll bring my drill and extra screwdrivers, and once you’ve got the tool list tightened up, send me whatever else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a big help, Gus—thank you. I’ll send you the updated list once I finish checking supplies, but we do know we’ve got spare screws, tape, and some gloves on hand already.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — just a quick update: the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, and I still have you down for the after-drop-off window before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me, and I’m still good to help after drop-off as long as I’m wrapped up before pickup around 2:45 to 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Faye — I’ve got you set for the after-drop-off window on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll make sure you’re wrapped before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—just remind me, it’s Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, right, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late jumping in—yeah, Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, and if you can bring gloves and a hammer, we’ll start on the fence behind the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, got it—Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, and I’ll bring gloves and a hammer. Anything else I should grab?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still a little unclear on the full list, Oren—do you know what we’re fixing first and where help’s most needed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I’m fuzzy on the full order, but I know they wanted hand tools kept separate from the spare parts, so I can start there unless we still need more volunteers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps—keeping the hand tools separate sounds like a good start. If you hear whether Saturday still needs more people, let me know?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Appreciate it, Uli—I’ve got you and Sam on the list, and I’ll have the drill and screwdrivers at the lot so you can jump in when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll bring my work gloves and keep an eye on things when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Uli—that’ll help a lot. Once you get there, I’ll point you and Sam toward whichever repairs need hands first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still in, Eli, but can we confirm the headcount and who’s bringing which tools before we call it set?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, let’s confirm it properly—meet at the community shed at nine, I’ll bring the extension cords, and we’ll make a clear headcount and tool list before we start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks—if we’ve got the headcount and one shared list sorted at the shed first, I’ll feel a lot better about keeping the repair drive manageable.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 10 in my driveway—bring small appliances or tools, and I’ll sort jobs when people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo—I’ve got the repair drive noted for Saturday at 10 in your driveway, and I’ll be there a little early to help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—come by around 9:45, and we’ll set up a table for check-ins and tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far—what’s the latest, and should I plan on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes—plan on Saturday; it’s turning into a neighborhood repair drive, and I’m inviting everyone tonight, so I’ll put you down and send over the details I have.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds good—please put me down, and send me whatever details you’ve got once you hear more.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the list going for the repair drive—tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what’s on hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good—that should help keep things organized. I’m still out running errands, but keep me posted on volunteer headcount and where the tool drop-off’s landing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You got it—I’ll keep tracking the volunteer count, and once I finish checking the supply bin I’ll let you know where the tool drop-off is landing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, where’s the shared repair list now, and how many requests and open volunteer slots are actually on it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s on the shared neighborhood sheet, and last I checked we had a good handful of repair requests with a few volunteer spots still open—I’m waiting on the final confirmation this afternoon, then I’ll send everyone the exact details so it stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: A good handful isn’t enough—how many are confirmed right now, and which repair types still don’t have volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re still meeting by the community shed for the repair drive this weekend, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara—I just want to confirm whether we’ve only got the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence listed, or if there’s a third repair already confirmed before I say anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: As far as I know, it’s still just the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence—I haven’t had a third repair confirmed yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it’s still the repair drive, but I’m honestly waiting on Jules or Hana to confirm the time and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Noah, last I’ve been telling folks it’s Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, and people have been dropping off tools all morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—sorry, I missed that change; if it’s Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway now, I’ll start repeating that and check with Jules or Hana so I don’t send people wrong.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, what’s the current count on repair requests, and who still hasn’t signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I don’t have the count in my head just now, but I know I can sort the donated parts if you point me to the boxes, and I did mean to ask if we still need more volunteers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, we still need a clear volunteer count for Saturday, but first who has the actual request list right now, and can you sort the donated parts today once I point you to the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far, Hana—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Last I could confirm, Saturday’s still the plan and the only confirmed jobs are the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, but I’d still like to double-check before we spread that around too widely.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks—that lines up with what I’d heard, so I’ll hold off repeating it until it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still on board, Kira, but I really don’t want us calling it settled until we’ve confirmed the headcount and who’s actually bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Exactly—can we get that confirmed first, just so we know who’s actually coming and what tools they’re bringing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s what I need too—once we’ve got a firm headcount and a tool list, I’ll feel a lot better about moving ahead.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Dane, I’ve got the repair drive pinned to Maple Street by the community garden, and I’m still tracking the bench, the fence panel, and the Cedar bus stop light.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I’m late—thanks for the update. How’s it all going so far?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Pretty well so far—I’ve still got it set for Maple Street by the community garden, and I’m just waiting to lock down headcount and tool assignments before I call things settled.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive after drop-off, as long as I’m free again for pickup around 2:45 to 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works fine, Faye — join us after drop-off, and we’ll make sure you’re free again by 2:45 so the plan stays tidy.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Eli — I can head over right after drop-off and stay until I need to leave for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—good turnout so far, and I’m making sure everyone gets the confirmed details once the time and spot are locked in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—Gus has me down for the lot Saturday at 9, and I’m bringing my toolbox to help with the small fixes and sort the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a huge help, Sam—thank you. I’m still waiting on the final confirmation for the exact time and spot, so hold tight on the 9 o’clock lot plan until I send the update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, and I think it’s mostly the bench, the fence panel, and the Cedar bus stop light.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—bring the bench hardware if you have it, and we’ll start with the fence panel first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I’ll bring the bench hardware if I can find it, and we’ll start on the fence panel at 10.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—that helps a lot. When you finish this afternoon, send me the full list so I can match everything to the Sunday setup at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Rosa—I’ll send you the full list this afternoon, and for now I can confirm we’ve got spare screws, tape, and gloves on hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo—thank you. Once you send the full list, I’ll line it up with what we need for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mara, it’s coming together nicely—Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, and folks have been dropping off tools and asking how they can help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—that lines up well; I’m starting with the wobbly bikes and the lamp rewiring, and we could still use a couple more hands on the bike side.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s lovely, Mara—I’ll spread the word that we still need a couple more hands for the bikes, since folks seem eager to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Uli, the plan for the repair drive is to meet by the community shed at nine, sort the tools, and then split up—I’ve been repeating it to everyone so turnout stays strong.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that sounds right—thanks for keeping it consistent. We’re still centered on the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence unless Jules says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence first unless Jules changes it—I’ll keep repeating that so everyone heads to the shed at nine ready to split up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still a little fuzzy on the plan, Ira—do you know if the shed at nine is still the first stop?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, Rey, so I don’t want to lock that in yet—can you check if the headcount and tool commitments are confirmed first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can check on that and let you know what I hear before we settle the shed timing.
